phases.objective: Bind the separate local Staging RESET and GRANT confirmations to the exact expected commit with unambiguous PowerShell interpolation, and permanently reject the previously ambiguous unbraced variable form before any database mutation can begin.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Recover-StagingDatabases.ps1 receives separate RESET and GRANT confirmation strings bound to the exact certified main SHA.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The recovery entrypoint accepts only the intended exact-SHA confirmation syntax, rejects stale or malformed confirmation strings before database work, and preserves the existing Staging-only recovery boundary.
steps: Build the expected RESET and GRANT confirmation values using braced ExpectedCommit interpolation before the colon delimiter.
Compare both supplied confirmations case-sensitively before Docker, schema import, or grant reconciliation begins.
Run the static recovery contract verifier and require the braced form for both confirmations.
Reject the previous unbraced $ExpectedCommit: source form so the interpolation ambiguity cannot regress.
After governed merge, require a fresh exact-main Staging eligibility result and newly generated local confirmations before any recovery attempt.
assertions: RESET_LOCAL_STAGING_DATABASES and APPLY_STAGING_ROLE_GRANTS bind to the complete exact commit SHA rather than an ambiguous PowerShell variable token.
The regression verifier requires ${ExpectedCommit} before the colon and rejects the old $ExpectedCommit: form.
A confirmation mismatch remains fail-closed before database reset, schema import, or grant mutation.
This change grants no Production, provider, Hostinger, Cloudflare, ruleset, secret, or cross-environment mutation authority.
Live Staging certification remains mandatory after merge before local recovery proceeds.
